themes.title: Big pharma doubles down on AI R&D
themes.description: Lilly's $2.75B Insilico licensing deal and $1B, 5-year NVIDIA co-innovation lab, plus Novartis's renewed Isomorphic partnership and new Chai Discovery collaboration, signal AI is now core R&D infrastructure, not a pilot program.

themes.title: AI-native platforms keep raising at scale
themes.description: Isomorphic Labs closed a $2.1B Series B in May 2026; NewLimit closed a $435M Series C in June 2026 at a $3.1B valuation — investor appetite for platform bets remains strong even as public names stay volatile.

themes.title: The clinic is the real test now
themes.description: Over 173 AI-discovered drug programs are in clinical development with 15–20 expected to enter pivotal trials in 2026, but zero have reached full FDA approval — Insilico's rentosertib Phase IIa remains the field's clearest proof point.

themes.title: Public AI-biotech names swing hard on single data points
themes.description: Recursion fell ~7.9% on one unfavorable trial readout in mid-July, while Relay Therapeutics collected both a Zacks downgrade to Strong Sell and fresh Buy initiations within the same two weeks.

private_watchlist.name: Isomorphic Labs
private_watchlist.note: AlphaFold 3 lineage; Thrive Capital-led round adds MGX, Temasek, CapitalG & UK Sovereign AI Fund alongside Alphabet/GV. Partnerships with Novartis, Lilly & J&J; first oncology clinical trials expected by year-end 2026.

private_watchlist.name: Insilico Medicine
private_watchlist.note: Rentosertib Phase IIa readout in IPF still the field's clearest clinical proof point; listed on HKEX (Dec 2025, $292M IPO), now stacking a Lilly licensing pact and a BIO 2026 CNS collaboration with SK Biopharmaceuticals.

private_watchlist.name: Xaira Therapeutics
private_watchlist.note: Launched X-Cell, its first virtual cell model (4.9B parameters, trained on the X-Atlas/Pisces dataset), in March 2026. Shifting from secrecy to dealmaking — hired a new SVP of Business Development in July.

private_watchlist.name: NewLimit
private_watchlist.note: Epigenetic reprogramming for longevity (Founders Fund, Lilly Ventures, Jun 2026); cites a prototype that reverses aging in human liver cells, targeting clinical entry as early as 2027. Retro Biosciences also notable at a $1.8B valuation with an Alzheimer's trial underway.

bear_case.title: Biology still fails in the clinic
bear_case.description: Of 173 AI-discovered programs now in clinical development, zero have reached full FDA approval; Recursion fell ~7.9% on a single unfavorable readout on Jul 16, 2026 — a reminder that one Phase IIa success is not field-wide validation.

bear_case.title: Catalyst-driven volatility
bear_case.description: These stocks trade on announcements; between catalysts they drift and dilute. Relay (RLAY) collected both fresh Buy initiations and a Zacks downgrade to Strong Sell within the same two weeks in July. Generate (GENB) and Eikon (EIKN) both traded below their Feb 2026 IPO prices shortly after debut.

bear_case.title: Platform-value skepticism
bear_case.description: If pharma can license AI tools cheaply (or build in-house), platform companies may capture less value than valuations imply. The broader AI trade faces its own version of this: hyperscalers' ~$660–690B in planned 2026 infrastructure spend dwarfs the AI software revenue it's meant to support.

bear_case.title: Rate sensitivity
bear_case.description: Long-duration biotech cash flows are highly sensitive to rates; macro can swamp fundamentals regardless of platform progress.

catalysts.title: Zacks downgrades Relay Therapeutics to Strong Sell
catalysts.description: Came just days after JPMorgan (Overweight) and Canaccord (Buy) initiations on zovegalisib — a snapshot of how split sentiment is on AI-native oncology names right now.

catalysts.title: Recursion (RXRX) drops ~7.9% on trial data
catalysts.description: Unfavorable readout dented sentiment days after ARK Invest added to its position; underscores binary clinical risk even for well-capitalized AI-native platforms.

catalysts.title: NewLimit closes $435M Series C at $3.1B valuation
catalysts.description: Founders Fund and Lilly Ventures back the round; company cites a prototype reversing aging in human liver cells and plans clinical entry as early as 2027.

catalysts.title: Isomorphic Labs raises $2.1B Series B
catalysts.description: Thrive Capital-led round with Alphabet, GV, MGX, Temasek, CapitalG and the UK Sovereign AI Fund — one of the largest private AI-biotech rounds on record.

catalysts.title: Eli Lilly × Insilico $2.75B licensing pact
catalysts.description: Record AI-drug research & licensing agreement — the largest single Lilly-AI deal to date; paired with a $1B, 5-year NVIDIA co-innovation lab.

catalysts.title: Recursion Q2 2026 earnings
catalysts.description: Consensus expects an EPS loss of $0.24 on ~$17.3M revenue; watch for updates on REC-4881, REC-1245 and cash runway (into early 2028 as of Q1).
